submission.justification: Crystal-K3 has the best simulated resolution at 662 keV: 2.90% FWHM at 5 cm, against 4.78% for K2 and 8.14% for K1. This matches the 2025 summary, which says thickness has little effect in the 3-8 cm range, so I chose 5 cm and did not scan other thicknesses. I found no intrinsic-background data for any candidate in the project documents. The simulation tool only returns resolution. The 0.5 counts/kg/day hard limit is therefore unverified. This recommendation is conditional on a vendor-certified or measured background for K3. If K3 exceeds the budget, the fallback is K2, then K1, each subject to the same check.

requirements.requirement: Best possible energy resolution at 662 keV
requirements.evidence: Simulated at 5 cm: K3 2.90%, K2 4.78%, K1 8.14% FWHM. K3 is best.
No document or tool gives intrinsic background for any candidate. This must be verified before procurement.

requirements.requirement: Crystal is one of the three candidates
